_source: Link's procedure table, animation table and state transitions, mined from the zeldaret/tww decompilation at Z:/memRip/sources/tww (CC0) on 2026-08-21. Primary evidence: include/d/actor/d_a_player_main.h (enum daPy_PROC at :415, enum daPy_ANM at :637, the ModeFlg_* set at :898, ProcInitTableEntry at :2343), src/d/actor/d_a_player_main_data.inc (daPy_lk_c::mProcInitTable at :222 - 219 entries, daPy_lk_c::mDemoProcInitFuncTable at :444, daPy_lk_c::mAnmDataTable at :1031 - 234 entries, and the mSword/mBoko/mHammerAnmIndexTable variant tables at :698 / :809 / :920), and the proc*_init / proc* bodies in src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp plus the 20 d_a_player_*.inc ability files. Clip file names come from assets/GZLE01/res/Object/LkAnm.h, whose dRes_INDEX_LKANM_BCK_<NAME>_e symbols are generated by tools/converters/res_arc.py from the upper-cased file names inside LkAnm.arc; 'waits.bck' and 'LkAnm.arc' are both confirmed verbatim in the ripped disc manifest at Z:/3d ripper/out/rip/GZLE01/disc_manifest.json, so <NAME>.lower() + '.bck' is the mapping used here. All file:line references are relative to Z:/memRip/sources/tww. Every daPy_PROC value 0x00-0xDA is present: nothing is inferred or invented, and the two states that no code can enter are marked reachable:false with the evidence for that claim. Numeric tuning (speeds, gravity, frame windows, fall heights) is deliberately NOT repeated here - it lives in Z:/memRip/knowledge/gamecube/link-movement-constants.md and its companion link-hio-constants.json, and this file references those constants by name. Cutscene animation ids for the .stb side are in gcrip/data/ww_demo_anims.json; the bridge between the two is daPy_lk_c::mDemoProcInitFuncTable, listed under _transitions.dispatchers. No function in d_a_player_main.cpp or the d_a_player_*.inc files is marked NONMATCHING or stubbed in this decomp - all 219 proc bodies and 216 proc*_init bodies were read as real C++.

_states.name: SCOPE
_states.meaning: First-person scope view: Telescope (param 0x20) or Picto Box aim; body frozen in the blended locomotion pose, facing follows the camera.

_states.name: SUBJECTIVITY
_states.meaning: First-person look-around (R with no item, or R while crouched); ModeFlg_SUBJECT, body angle follows the camera, exits to wait / crouch / crouch-defense.
_states.note: skipped when entered from a crouch (i_crouch != 0): the crouch pose is kept.

_states.name: CALL
_states.meaning: Call the NPC partner (Command Melody 'come here'): plays YOBU, turns to the partner, then raises onNpcCallCommand().

_states.name: CONTROLL_WAIT
_states.meaning: Idle body while the player is controlling someone else (Medli/Makar under the Command Melody); holds the NENRIKI concentration pose.

_states.name: WAIT
_states.meaning: Normal standing idle; runs the idle-variation logic (WAITB / WAITATOB alt idles, low-HP idle, guard idle).

_states.name: FREE_WAIT
_states.meaning: Free-idle used inside events/demos: plays one of the FREEA/FREEB/FREED loose stand poses without the idle-variation machinery.

_states.name: MOVE
_states.meaning: Normal ground locomotion; speed-blended walk/run through setBlendMoveAnime (WAITS/WALK/DASH, slope/heavy/carry variants).

_states.name: ATN_MOVE
_states.meaning: Z-target strafing locomotion with no locked actor (attention direction only); ATN blend set.

_states.name: ATN_ACTOR_WAIT
_states.meaning: Z-targeted idle facing a locked-on actor.
_states.note: falls back to setBlendMoveAnime when checkAtnWaitAnime() is false.

_states.name: ATN_ACTOR_MOVE
_states.meaning: Z-targeted strafing locomotion around a locked-on actor.

_states.name: SIDE_STEP
_states.meaning: Z-target side hop (ATNJL/ATNJR), airborne (ModeFlg_MIDAIR).

_states.name: SIDE_STEP_LAND
_states.meaning: Landing recovery of the Z-target side hop.

_states.name: CROUCH_DEFENSE
_states.meaning: Crouch with the shield raised (R held with a shield); body leans with the stick.

_states.name: CROUCH_DEFENSE_SLIP
_states.meaning: Crouch-shield while sliding down a slope (DIFENCEA).

_states.name: CROUCH
_states.meaning: Plain crouch (R held, no shield equipped).

_states.name: CRAWL_START
_states.meaning: Start of crawling: the LIE lie-down animation before crawl movement takes over.

_states.name: CRAWL_MOVE
_states.meaning: Crawling forward/back under stick control (LIEFORWARD, speed driven off the anim frame).

_states.name: CRAWL_AUTO_MOVE
_states.meaning: Scripted crawl along a fixed path (used for crawl-space entrances); no stick input.
_states.note: no animation call: keeps the LIEFORWARD crawl anim already running from CRAWL_MOVE.

_states.name: CRAWL_END
_states.meaning: End of crawling: LIE played in reverse to stand back up.

_states.name: WHIDE_READY
_states.meaning: Start of wall-hide (back to a wall): moves into the WALL flatten pose.

_states.name: WHIDE_WAIT
_states.meaning: Wall-hide idle, back flat against the wall (WALL / WALLDW for the low variant).

_states.name: WHIDE_MOVE
_states.meaning: Wall-hide sidestep along the wall (WALLWL/WALLWR and their DW low variants).

_states.name: WHIDE_PEEP
_states.meaning: Wall-hide peek around the corner (WALLPL/WALLPR and DW variants).

_states.name: WAIT_TURN
_states.meaning: Standing about-face turn (ROT) when the stick asks for more than ~168 degrees from a standstill.

_states.name: MOVE_TURN
_states.meaning: Running turn / turn-around while moving; keeps the locomotion blend and rotates.

_states.name: SLIP
_states.meaning: Skid stop (SLIP) when reversing at speed on non-ice ground.

_states.name: SLIDE_FRONT
_states.meaning: Sliding down a steep slope facing forwards.

_states.name: SLIDE_BACK
_states.meaning: Sliding down a steep slope facing backwards.

_states.name: SLIDE_FRONT_LAND
_states.meaning: Recovery after a forward slope slide ends.

_states.name: SLIDE_BACK_LAND
_states.meaning: Recovery after a backward slope slide ends.

_states.name: FRONT_ROLL
_states.meaning: Forward roll (A while running, or landing with the stick forward).

_states.name: FRONT_ROLL_CRASH
_states.meaning: Forward roll into a wall: the crash/bonk (ROLLFMIS) that stuns Link briefly.

_states.name: NOCK_BACK_END
_states.meaning: Recovery from being knocked back into a wall (reuses the roll-crash pose).

_states.name: SIDE_ROLL
_states.meaning: Sideways landing roll (MROLLL/MROLLR) when landing with sideways stick.

_states.name: BACK_JUMP
_states.meaning: Backflip (Z-target back jump, ROLLB).

_states.name: BACK_JUMP_LAND
_states.meaning: Backflip landing recovery.

_states.name: AUTO_JUMP
_states.meaning: Auto-jump off a ledge at run speed (JMPST) - the game's only 'jump'.

_states.name: LAND
_states.meaning: Landing recovery from a normal fall (JMPEDS tail).

_states.name: LAND_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Damaging / hard landing: collapse (LANDDAMA), lie for a timer, then stand up (LANDDAMAST).

_states.name: FALL
_states.meaning: Free fall (JMPEDS hold); watches for ledge grab, wall catch, jump attack, Deku Leaf.

_states.name: SLOW_FALL
_states.meaning: Slow fall with a capped fall speed (-20/frame), used for gentle scripted drops.

_states.name: SMALL_JUMP
_states.meaning: Small hop (JMPST) for short height changes.

_states.name: VERTICAL_JUMP
_states.meaning: Vertical jump up to grab a ledge above (VJMP).

_states.name: HANG_START
_states.meaning: Grab a ledge from midair (ledge catch) - moves into the VJMPCHA hang pose.

_states.name: HANG_FALL_START
_states.meaning: Grab a ledge by walking off it (fall-start hang, HANGING).

_states.name: HANG_UP
_states.meaning: Pull up hand-over-hand onto the ledge (HANGUP), then climb / shimmy / hang.

_states.name: HANG_WAIT
_states.meaning: Hanging idle on a ledge (VJMPCHA).

_states.name: HANG_MOVE
_states.meaning: Shimmy sideways along a ledge (HANGMOVEL/HANGMOVER).

_states.name: HANG_CLIMB
_states.meaning: Climb up from a hang onto the ledge (VJMPCL) - the get-up.

_states.name: HANG_WALL_CATCH
_states.meaning: Catch a wall/pillar in midair (VJMPCHB grip pose).

_states.name: PUSH_PULL_WAIT
_states.meaning: Holding a pushable/pullable block, idle (WAITPUSHPULL).

_states.name: PUSH_MOVE
_states.meaning: Pushing a block (WALKPUSH).

_states.name: PULL_MOVE
_states.meaning: Pulling a block (WALKPULL).

_states.name: SWIM_UP
_states.meaning: Surface / enter water swimming (SWIMP), including coming up for air.

_states.name: SWIM_WAIT
_states.meaning: Treading water idle (SWIMWAIT).

_states.name: SWIM_MOVE
_states.meaning: Swimming (SWIMING); drains the stamina meter.

_states.name: LADDER_UP_START
_states.meaning: Mount a ladder from below and start climbing up (blend into the ladder pose).
_states.note: procLadderUpStart_init_sub sets the actual grip pose; setAnimeUnequip puts the item away first.

_states.name: LADDER_UP_END
_states.meaning: Step off the top of a ladder (LADDERUPEDL/R, left- or right-foot variant).

_states.name: LADDER_DOWN_START
_states.meaning: Mount a ladder from above and start climbing down.
_states.note: procLadderDownStart_init_sub sets the actual grip pose.

_states.name: LADDER_DOWN_END
_states.meaning: Step off the bottom of a ladder (LADDERDWEDL/R).

_states.name: LADDER_MOVE
_states.meaning: Climb a ladder up/down (LADDERLTOR / LADDERRTOL alternating hands).

_states.name: CLIMB_UP_START
_states.meaning: Grab a climbable wall / vine from the ground and start climbing.
_states.note: procClimbUpStart_init_sub sets the actual grip pose.

_states.name: CLIMB_DOWN_START
_states.meaning: Mount a climbable wall from above (LADDERDWST) to climb down.

_states.name: CLIMB_MOVE_UP_DOWN
_states.meaning: Climb a wall / vine vertically (reuses the ladder hand-over-hand clips).

_states.name: CLIMB_MOVE_SIDE
_states.meaning: Traverse a climbable wall sideways (FCLIMBSLIDELUP/RUP).

_states.name: CUT_A
_states.meaning: Sword swing A: the locked-on neutral slash (CUTA).

_states.name: CUT_F
_states.meaning: Sword swing: forward thrust/stab (CUTF).

_states.name: CUT_R
_states.meaning: Sword swing: right horizontal (CUTR).

_states.name: CUT_L
_states.meaning: Sword swing: left horizontal (CUTL) - also the free (unlocked) default swing.

_states.name: CUT_EA
_states.meaning: Combo finisher A (CUTEA), reached at combo step 4 pushing right/forward.

_states.name: CUT_EB
_states.meaning: Combo finisher B (CUTEB), reached at combo step 4 otherwise.

_states.name: CUT_EX_A
_states.meaning: Extra combo swing A (EXCA1), combo step 5.

_states.name: CUT_EX_B
_states.meaning: Extra combo swing B (EXCB1), combo step 6 with a neutral stick.

_states.name: CUT_EX_MJ
_states.meaning: Extra combo jumping/rolling slash (MROLLLC/MROLLRC), combo steps 5-6.

_states.name: CUT_KESA
_states.meaning: Kesa (diagonal downward) slash (CUTKESA), combo step 5 pushing right.

_states.name: WEAPON_NORMAL_SWING
_states.meaning: Swing a picked-up enemy weapon, normal swing (reuses CUTBOKO).

_states.name: WEAPON_SIDE_SWING
_states.meaning: Swing a picked-up weapon sideways (HAMSWINGA shape).

_states.name: WEAPON_FRONT_SWING_READY
_states.meaning: Wind up an overhead swing with a picked-up weapon (HAMSWINGBPRE).

_states.name: WEAPON_FRONT_SWING
_states.meaning: Overhead swing impact with a picked-up weapon (HAMSWINGBHIT).

_states.name: WEAPON_FRONT_SWING_END
_states.meaning: Overhead swing recovery with a picked-up weapon (HAMSWINGBEND).

_states.name: WEAPON_THROW
_states.meaning: Throw the held enemy weapon (Boko stick / Moblin spear).

_states.name: HAMMER_SIDE_SWING
_states.meaning: Skull Hammer sideways swing (HAMSWINGA).

_states.name: HAMMER_FRONT_SWING_READY
_states.meaning: Skull Hammer overhead wind-up (HAMSWINGBPRE).

_states.name: HAMMER_FRONT_SWING
_states.meaning: Skull Hammer overhead impact (HAMSWINGBHIT).

_states.name: HAMMER_FRONT_SWING_END
_states.meaning: Skull Hammer overhead recovery (HAMSWINGBEND).

_states.name: CUT_TURN
_states.meaning: Spin attack release: ANM_CUTTURN with the sword equipped, ANM_CUTTURNC with anything else; the BOOL argument only picks the start frame (mCutTurn.field_0xC vs field_0x8).

_states.name: CUT_ROLL
_states.meaning: Spin-attack roll-out (CUTTURNB) after a full spin.

_states.name: CUT_ROLL_END
_states.meaning: End of the spin attack - the dizzy/out-of-breath recovery (WAITQ).

_states.name: CUT_TURN_CHARGE
_states.meaning: Charging the spin attack (holding B, CUTTURNP).

_states.name: CUT_TURN_MOVE
_states.meaning: Moving while charging the spin attack (CUTTURNPWFB / PWLR).

_states.name: CUT_REVERSE
_states.meaning: Sword bounce-back after a swing hits a shield or hard geometry (CUTRER); Link is pushed 12 units/frame backwards.
_states.clip_note: procCutReverse_init takes the clip as a parameter; changeCutReverseProc passes ANM_CUTRER (and ANM_JATTACK, which makes the init return early without changing state).

_states.name: JUMP_CUT
_states.meaning: Jump attack (JATTACK) - A while Z-targeted at distance.

_states.name: JUMP_CUT_LAND
_states.meaning: Jump attack landing (JATTACKLAND).

_states.name: BT_JUMP
_states.meaning: Parry jump toward the enemy (MJMP), the first half of the A-button counter.

_states.name: BT_JUMP_CUT
_states.meaning: Parry jump slash (MJMPC), the counter's hit.

_states.name: BT_SLIDE
_states.meaning: Battle slide - decel-only state; UNREACHABLE in retail: no procBtSlide_init exists and daPyProc_BT_SLIDE_e is never passed to commonProcInit.
_states.unreachable_evidence: No procBtSlide_init exists and daPyProc_BT_SLIDE_e appears nowhere in src/ - the state can never be entered in retail code. procBtSlide() itself is a plain decelerate-then-checkNextMode body (src/d/actor/d_a_player_battle.inc:217).

_states.name: BT_ROLL
_states.meaning: Parry roll around the enemy (MROLLL/MROLLR).

_states.name: BT_ROLL_CUT
_states.meaning: Parry roll slash (MROLLLC/MROLLRC), the back-stab half of the roll counter.

_states.name: BT_VERTICAL_JUMP
_states.meaning: Parry vault over the enemy (MSTEPOVER).

_states.name: BT_VERTICAL_JUMP_CUT
_states.meaning: Parry vault slash (MSTEPOVERA) delivered mid-vault.

_states.name: BT_VERTICAL_JUMP_LAND
_states.meaning: Parry vault landing (MSTEPOVERLAND).

_states.name: GUARD_CRASH
_states.meaning: Guard crash (shield broken through) - decel + timer; UNREACHABLE as an entered state: commonProcInit is never called with daPyProc_GUARD_CRASH_e, only two mCurProc comparisons read it.
_states.unreachable_evidence: commonProcInit is never called with daPyProc_GUARD_CRASH_e; the enum value is only read in two mCurProc comparisons (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:1307, :1456). procGuardCrash() exists (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7491) but nothing enters it.

_states.name: DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Normal damage: directional flinch (DAMB/DAMF/DAML/DAMR) plus knockback along the damage vector.

_states.name: POLY_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Damage from touching hurtful geometry (spikes/lava floor edge): DAM in place, no knockback.

_states.name: LARGE_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Large damage / launch: knocked off the feet (DAMFF/DAMFB/DAMFL/DAMFR), airborne until ground or wall.

_states.name: LARGE_DAMAGE_UP
_states.meaning: Large damage landing: hit the ground and get back up (DAMF*UP clips).

_states.name: LARGE_DAMAGE_WALL
_states.meaning: Large damage into a wall: slam and slide down (DAMF*UP clips).

_states.name: LAVA_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Lava / fire damage (LAVADAM) - Link jumps up burning.

_states.name: ELEC_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Electric damage (DAMBIRI) - the shocked shudder.

_states.name: GUARD_SLIP
_states.meaning: Shield-slip: a blow deflected off the shield pushes Link back (ATNGAL/ATNGAR/ATNGAHAM).

_states.name: GRAB_READY
_states.meaning: Reach out to grab / lift an object (GRABP).

_states.name: GRAB_UP
_states.meaning: Lift the object over the head (GRABUP).

_states.name: GRAB_MISS
_states.meaning: Grab missed - nothing there to lift (GRABNG).

_states.name: GRAB_THROW
_states.meaning: Throw the carried object (GRABTHROW; GRABRE for the rebound case).

_states.name: GRAB_PUT
_states.meaning: Set the carried object back down (GRABUP played toward GRABWAIT).

_states.name: GRAB_WAIT
_states.meaning: Carrying a normal object, idle/moving (GRABWAIT).

_states.name: GRAB_HEAVY_WAIT
_states.meaning: Carrying a heavy object (GRABWAITB) - restricted movement.

_states.name: GRAB_REBOUND
_states.meaning: Rebound after trying to lift something immovable (GRABRE).

_states.name: ROPE_SUBJECT
_states.meaning: Grappling Hook aim, first person (ATNRS ready pose, ModeFlg_SUBJECT).

_states.name: ROPE_READY
_states.meaning: Rope caught: settle into the swing (ROPECATCH / ROPESWINGB).

_states.name: ROPE_SWING
_states.meaning: Swinging on a rope (blended ROPESWINGF/ROPESWINGB by phase).

_states.name: ROPE_HANG_WAIT
_states.meaning: Hanging still on a rope (ROPEWAIT).

_states.name: ROPE_UP
_states.meaning: Climbing up the rope (ROPECLIMB).

_states.name: ROPE_DOWN
_states.meaning: Climbing down the rope (ROPEDOWN).

_states.name: ROPE_SWING_START
_states.meaning: Kick-off that starts a rope swing (ROPESWINGB).

_states.name: ROPE_MOVE
_states.meaning: Moving while holding the Grappling Hook ready (third-person, ATN blend + ROPETHROWWAIT upper).
_states.note: plus ropethrowwait.bck on the upper body (setActAnimeUpper).

_states.name: ROPE_THROW_CATCH
_states.meaning: Grappling Hook throw / catch swipe (ROPETHROWCATCH) - also the steal-from-enemy grab.

_states.name: ROPE_UP_HANG
_states.meaning: Pull up from the top of a rope onto the ledge (VJMP).

_states.name: BOOMERANG_SUBJECT
_states.meaning: Boomerang aim, first person (ATNRS + BOOMWAIT upper, ModeFlg_SUBJECT).

_states.name: BOOMERANG_MOVE
_states.meaning: Moving while the Boomerang is readied (third-person, ATN blend + BOOMWAIT upper).
_states.note: plus boomwait.bck on the upper body.

_states.name: BOOMERANG_CATCH
_states.meaning: Catch the returning Boomerang (BOOMCATCH).

_states.name: HOOKSHOT_SUBJECT
_states.meaning: Hookshot aim, first person (ATNLS + HOOKSHOTWAIT upper).

_states.name: HOOKSHOT_MOVE
_states.meaning: Moving while the Hookshot is readied (third-person).
_states.note: plus hookshotwait.bck on the upper body.

_states.name: HOOKSHOT_FLY
_states.meaning: Being pulled by the Hookshot (HOOKSHOTJMP), airborne.

_states.name: SHIP_READY
_states.meaning: Grabbing the side of the King of Red Lions to board (VJMPCL climb-in).

_states.name: SHIP_JUMP_RIDE
_states.meaning: Jumping aboard the boat from a run (SLIPICE pose reused as the scramble).

_states.name: SHIP_STEER
_states.meaning: Sitting at the tiller steering the boat.

_states.name: SHIP_PADDLE
_states.meaning: Paddling the boat with no sail (FREEA/FREEB/FREED oar poses).
_states.note: procShipPaddle itself swaps in FREEA / FREEB / FREED for the oar strokes.

_states.name: SHIP_SCOPE
_states.meaning: Using the Telescope while aboard the boat.

_states.name: SHIP_BOOMERANG
_states.meaning: Aiming the Boomerang from the boat.

_states.name: SHIP_HOOKSHOT
_states.meaning: Aiming the Hookshot from the boat.

_states.name: SHIP_BOW
_states.meaning: Aiming the Bow from the boat.

_states.name: SHIP_CANNON
_states.meaning: Firing the boat's cannon.

_states.name: SHIP_CRANE
_states.meaning: Working the salvage crane (SALVLR/SALVRWAIT/SALVLWAIT and the good/bad reaction clips).
_states.note: procShipCrane swaps in SALVLR / SALVRBAD / SALVLBAD / SALVRGOOD / SALVLGOOD.

_states.name: SHIP_GET_OFF
_states.meaning: Running off the boat back onto land (DASH at 8 units/frame toward a computed ledge point).

_states.name: SHIP_RESTART
_states.meaning: Boat restart / respawn at sea (SEARESET).

_states.name: FAN_SWING
_states.meaning: Deku Leaf swing - the wind gust (USEFANA).

_states.name: FAN_GLIDE
_states.meaning: Deku Leaf glide (USEFANB), airborne, drains magic.

_states.name: BOW_SUBJECT
_states.meaning: Bow aim, first person (ATNRS + ARROWSHOOT upper).

_states.name: BOW_MOVE
_states.meaning: Moving while the Bow is drawn (third-person).
_states.note: plus setBowReadyAnime on the upper body.

_states.name: VOMIT_READY
_states.meaning: Compressed inside a jump flower (a JBO 'Boko Bulb' launcher) ready to be shot into the air (MSTEPOVER).

_states.name: VOMIT_WAIT
_states.meaning: Sitting inside the jump flower waiting to be launched (VOMITJMP).

_states.name: VOMIT_JUMP
_states.meaning: Being fired through the air by a jump flower, or spat out of a warp pot (VOMITJMP); also forced by daPyFlg1_FORCE_VOMIT_JUMP(_SHORT).

_states.name: VOMIT_LAND
_states.meaning: Hard landing after a jump-flower / warp-pot launch (LANDDAMA collapse).

_states.name: TACT_WAIT
_states.meaning: Wind Waker out, idle with the baton raised (WAITTAKT).

_states.name: TACT_PLAY
_states.meaning: Conducting a song (TAKTKAZE / TAKTSIPPU / TAKTCHUYA / TAKTFUJIN / TAKTAYATSURI / TAKTCHISIN).

_states.name: TACT_PLAY_END
_states.meaning: Putting the Wind Waker away after conducting.

_states.name: TACT_PLAY_ORIGINAL
_states.meaning: Free conducting mode (the player waving the baton without a song, WAITTAKT).

_states.name: ICE_SLIP_FALL
_states.meaning: Slipping over on ice and falling (DAMF* launch clips).

_states.name: ICE_SLIP_FALL_UP
_states.meaning: Getting back up after an ice slip (DAMF*UP clips).

_states.name: ICE_SLIP_ALMOST_FALL
_states.meaning: Nearly slipping on ice - the wobble recovery (DAMB/DAMF/DAML/DAMR flinches).

_states.name: BOOTS_EQUIP
_states.meaning: Putting the Iron Boots on / taking them off (SETBOOTS).

_states.name: NOT_USE
_states.meaning: Item with no use here: Link holds it up and shows it to an event camera (PRESENTATIONB); reached from the item button when the item is owned but has no action.

_states.name: BOTTLE_DRINK
_states.meaning: Drinking from a bottle (BINDRINKPRE -> drinking -> after).

_states.name: BOTTLE_OPEN
_states.meaning: Opening a bottle to release its contents (BINOPENPRE/A/B).

_states.name: BOTTLE_SWING
_states.meaning: Scooping with a bottle - swing to catch (BINSWINGS/BINSWINGU).

_states.name: BOTTLE_GET
_states.meaning: Bottle successfully filled (BINGET).

_states.name: FOOD_THROW
_states.meaning: Throwing bait (ESAMAKI) - All-Purpose Bait.

_states.name: FOOD_SET
_states.meaning: Setting down a Hyoi Pear (SETHYOINOMI).

_states.name: DEMO_TOOL
_states.meaning: Cutscene tool state: Link's pose is streamed from the .stb (daPy_demo_c mode >= DEMO_NEW_ANM0_e); the bck id comes from his JSGSetData record in LkD00/LkD01.arc.
_states.note: the pose is streamed from the .stb: every anm heap index is cleared to -1 and dProcTool() writes the bck named by the actor's LkD00/LkD01.arc data record each frame.

_states.name: DEMO_TALK
_states.meaning: Cutscene talk pose (TALKA / WAITS) while an NPC conversation runs.

_states.name: DEMO_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Cutscene scripted damage flinch (DAMF).

_states.name: DEMO_HOLDUP
_states.meaning: Cutscene item hold-up (HOLDUP; WALLHOLDUP/DW variants when against a wall).

_states.name: DEMO_OPEN_TREASURE
_states.meaning: Opening a treasure chest (BOXOPENLINK / BOXOPENSHORTLINK for the small chest).

_states.name: DEMO_GET_ITEM
_states.meaning: Item-get pose (ITEMGET), the fanfare hold.

_states.name: DEMO_UNEQUIP
_states.meaning: Cutscene un-equip: put away whatever is in hand and blend back to the idle.
_states.note: plus setAnimeUnequip to put the held item away.

_states.name: DEMO_LAVA_DAMAGE
_states.meaning: Cutscene lava damage (LAVADAM).

_clips.note: daPy_ANM (0x00-0xE9, 234 values) indexes daPy_lk_c::mAnmDataTable, which gives a separate bck for the lower body (mUnderBckIdx) and the upper body (mUpperBckIdx) plus the two hand joint ids and a texture-animation index. Link is animated as two halves blended together: mFrameCtrlUnder[UNDER_MOVE0/1] and the UPPER_MOVE0/1/2 slots, so an 'upper' clip such as arrowshoot.bck can be laid over any lower-body clip. While the sword, a picked-up enemy weapon or the Skull Hammer is held, daPy_ANM 0x00-0x1A are re-routed through the matching variant table instead.

sword_equipped.note: daPy_lk_c::mSwordAnmIndexTable - replaces the under/upper bck of daPy_ANM 0x00-0x1A while the sword is drawn.

boko_stick_equipped.note: daPy_lk_c::mBokoAnmIndexTable - same range while a picked-up enemy weapon (Boko stick / Moblin spear) is held.

skull_hammer_equipped.note: daPy_lk_c::mHammerAnmIndexTable - same range while the Skull Hammer is held.

blend_helpers.note: speed-and-context blend: WAITS idle -> WALK -> DASH; DASHKAZE upper when running into wind, WALKHBOOTS(+KAZE) with Iron Boots, WALKSLOPE on a steep slope, WALKBARREL while carrying, WAITQ/SLIPICE when sliding to a stop on ice.
Z-target strafe blend: L/R stance idles (ATNLS/ATNRS) blended into the sidestep walks (ATNWLS/ATNWRS) and dashes (ATNDLS/ATNDRS).
Z-target backpedal blend: idle -> ATNWB walk-back -> ATNDB run-back.
wall-hide blend; the *DW rows are the low (ducked) variants.
rope swing blend driven by the pendulum phase.
the seated-on-the-boat base pose (VOYAGE1) plus the ship_jump2 / fn_hair1 sub-animations.
upper-body bow draw laid over whatever the lower body is doing.

dispatchers.name: commonProcInit(daPy_PROC)
dispatchers.what: Every proc*_init calls this first. It runs the leave-handler for mCurProc (stop SE, drop held rope/item, restore fall speed, delete the Deku Leaf, ...), then reads mProcInitTable[proc] and installs its ProcFunc in mCurProcFunc together with the entry's ModeFlg mask.

dispatchers.name: checkNextMode(int)
dispatchers.what: The master 'what do I do now' dispatcher every grounded proc calls when its animation finishes (arg 0) or when it wants an early cancel (arg 1, which returns false unless the stick is pushed or the action button is down). Order: forced vomit-jump flags -> changeSlideProc (steep slope) -> checkNextActionFromButton (items/sword/roll/jump) -> if Z-targeting: boomerang/bow/hookshot/rope ready modes, else ATN_ACTOR_WAIT / ATN_ACTOR_MOVE / changeWaitProc / ATN_MOVE -> otherwise WAIT_TURN (turn > 0x7800 from a standstill), SLIP (reversing above mSlip ratio on non-ice), MOVE_TURN, or MOVE -> finally checkJumpFlower.

dispatchers.name: changeWaitProc()
dispatchers.what: Idle chooser: GRAB_WAIT if carrying, BOOMERANG_CATCH if the boomcatch upper anim is playing, CONTROLL_WAIT if this actor is not the controlled player, else WAIT.

dispatchers.name: changeFrontWallTypeProc()
dispatchers.what: Turns setFrontWallType()'s mFrontWallType classification into a state: midair + type 7 -> HANG_START; grounded type 3 -> CLIMB_MOVE_UP_DOWN (vine/ladder wall); type 4 -> ladder; types 6/7/8/9 are the four ledge height bands (mWallCatch fields 0xC / 0x10 / 0x14) that pick small jump / wall catch / vertical jump / hang.

dispatchers.name: setFrontWallType()
dispatchers.what: Line-checks the wall in front at three heights, then classifies the ledge by (ledge_y - Link_y): < 27.09 nothing, < mWallCatch.0xC type 6, < 0x10 type 7, < 0x14 type 8, else type 9. Midair it is type 7 whenever the drop below is > 125 units.

dispatchers.name: changeDemoProc()
dispatchers.what: Maps daPy_demo_c::Mode_e to a demo proc through daPy_lk_c::mDemoProcInitFuncTable (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main_data.inc:444), a 76-entry array of *_init pointers with NULL holes. This is the table the .stb ANIMATION value for the actor named 'Link' indexes; see gcrip/data/ww_demo_anims.json.

sword_combo.counter: m34C4 (combo step, ++ on every entry); mCutCount = m34C4, or m34C4 - 2 once m34C4 > 4, and feeds the AT parameters. m34C5 is the queued 'B pressed again' request set in each procCut* body; m3578 is cleared on every chain step.
sword_combo.direction: getCutDirection() (src/d/actor/d_a_player_sword.inc:387) maps the stick against the lock-on / facing angle to DIR_FORWARD / DIR_RIGHT / DIR_LEFT / DIR_BACKWARD, or DIR_NONE when the stick is inside the 0.05 dead zone.

goes_to.dir: NONE without a lock / LEFT / BACKWARD

goes_to.clip: cutturn.bck with the sword equipped, cutturnc.bck otherwise

chain.goes_to: no branch matches - changeCutProc falls through and no new proc starts, so the swing that is running plays out and checkNextMode ends the combo.

sword_combo.special_finish: When m34C5 == 5 changeSpecialBattle() is tried first (the parry / finishing-blow prompt); if it fires the combo counter resets to 0 and no CUT_* state is entered.
sword_combo.window: Each procCut* body calls checkNextMode(1) once the frame passes that swing's cancel frame (mCut.mCutX.field_0xC), and sets m34C5 = 1 when the sword button is re-triggered before then; checkNextActionFromButton is what turns that into the next changeCutProc().

bounce.what: Called every frame of every swing. If the attack capsule hit a shield, or a line check from Link to mSwordTopPos crosses non-ground geometry, the swing turns into CUT_REVERSE with ANM_CUTRER (cutrer.bck): mNormalSpeed 12 backwards, facing + 0x8000. Passing ANM_JATTACK makes procCutReverse_init return true without changing state (a jump attack bounces off without a rebound state).

chooser.name: changeDamageProc()
chooser.what: Reads the collision result and picks DAMAGE / POLY_DAMAGE / LARGE_DAMAGE(param) / ELEC_DAMAGE / GUARD_SLIP. The int passed to procLargeDamage_init selects the knockback table row: -1 and -6 use the damage vector, -2 uses m3550 and costs a heart, -9 uses the damage vector at large-damage strength, -3 is the cutscene launch, -4 is the freeze case, -5 is the boss swallow.

normal.clip_rule: getDirectionFromAngle(damage vector relative to facing): DIR_BACKWARD -> ANM_DAMF (damf.bck), DIR_LEFT -> ANM_DAMR (damr.bck), DIR_RIGHT -> ANM_DAML (daml.bck), otherwise -> ANM_DAMB (damb.bck). Note the deliberate left/right swap: a blow arriving on Link's left plays the DAMR clip.
normal.knockback: mNormalSpeed = mDam.mDamage.field_0x10 * |damage vector XZ| + field_0xC, along cM_atan2s(vec.x, vec.z); body pitch/roll (m3564 / mBodyAngle) are driven by a sine ramp that peaks at mDamage.field_0x28 and decays over the rest of the clip.
normal.exit: procDamage() calls checkNextMode(0) once the eased speed is <= 0.001 and the clip has stopped.

poly.what: Damage from hurtful geometry: ANM_DAM (dam.bck) in place, mNormalSpeed = 0, no knockback.

large.clips: DAMFF / DAMFB / DAMFL / DAMFR by hit direction; Link leaves the ground (ModeFlg_MIDAIR).
large.resolves_to: On ground contact: changeSlideProc() first (slope), else LARGE_DAMAGE_UP (0x69). On wall contact above m35A0 speed: LARGE_DAMAGE_WALL (0x6A). Both play the matching DAMF*UP clip and end with the get-up.
large.guard: procLargeDamage_init returns false if mCurProc is already LARGE_DAMAGE, so the launch cannot re-trigger itself.

knockback_recovery.what: Re-uses ANM_ROLLFMIS (rollfmis.bck) with the mNockback table; entered from src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:6492 when a knockback run ends.

guard_slip.what: A blow the shield deflected: ATNGAL / ATNGAR (or ATNGAHAM with the hammer) push Link back without damage.

entering_the_air.FALL (0x27): procFall_init(int kind, f32 morf) at src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7293. kind 1 zeroes speed and snaps facing (a walk-off), kind 2 keeps a decaying horizontal speed, kind 0 is the scripted 'fall' event. Returns false if already falling. Plays ANM_JMPEDS with the caller's blend time (usually mWallCatch.field_0x54).
entering_the_air.AUTO_JUMP (0x24): procAutoJump_init at src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7094, ANM_JMPST: running off a ledge above mAutoJump.jump_min_speed with the stick pushed and the facing within 0x800 of the movement angle (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:5335).
entering_the_air.SMALL_JUMP (0x29): procSmallJump_init at src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7420, ANM_JMPST: the short hop for ledge type 6.
entering_the_air.SLOW_FALL (0x28): procSlowFall_init at src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7394, maxFallSpeed clamped to -20/frame.

landing_decision.name: changeLandProc(f32 blend)
landing_decision.input: drop = m35F0 (the y the fall started from) - current.pos.y, in world units; the thresholds are mFall.fall_height_damage1_m / _damage2_m x 100 (20 m and 60 m in retail).
order: drop >= 100 * fall.fall_height_damage2_m (6000 units) and the ground is not a Giant Flower -> LAND_DAMAGE(2), setDamagePoint(-2).

otherwise, if not carrying, stick > 0.5, the movement direction is not backwards, and (the previous state was CUT_EX_MJ, or the drop from m3688.y is >= 300 units), and the current-angle direction is FORWARD -> FRONT_ROLL (stick straight ahead, start frame fall.land_front_roll_start_frame) or SIDE_ROLL (stick to a side).
otherwise, if drop >= 0.5 * 100 * fall.fall_height_damage1_m (1000 units) and this is not the Gohma boss stage and the ground is not a Giant Flower -> LAND_DAMAGE(0): the non-damaging hard landing.
otherwise, VOMIT_LAND if the previous state was VOMIT_JUMP, checkNextMode(0) if a CUT_EX_MJ still has its follow-up queued, else LAND.
landing_decision.damaging_fall_shape: LAND_DAMAGE (procLandDamage_init, src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7235) plays ANM_LANDDAMA (landdama.bck) at fall.land_damage_anim_rate from fall.land_damage_anim_start_frame, holds mProcVar0.m34D0 frames (fall.land_damage_lie_timer = 30 when damaged, fall.hard_land_lie_timer = 3 when not), then procLandDamage() swaps in ANM_LANDDAMAST (landdamast.bck) at fall.land_damage_standup_rate_damaged (0.3) or _undamaged (1.2). checkNextMode(1) may cancel the stand-up after fall.land_damage_standup_cancel_frame; checkNextMode(0) ends it.
landing_decision.normal_land: LAND (procLand_init, src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7195) plays ANM_JMPEDS (under jmpeds.bck / upper jmped.bck) and cancels into checkNextMode(1) past mAutoJump.field_0x40, or checkNextMode(0) when the clip stops.

fall_land.in_air_branches: procFall() (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:7350) each frame: Deku Leaf (checkFanGlideProc), fall voice, ledge catch via changeFrontWallTypeProc (only after an 8-frame lockout when the fall started from a standstill; immediately, together with changeRopeSwingProc, when it started with speed), midair jump attack (checkJumpCutFromButton), item flight follow-ups, and ground contact -> changeLandProc.

ledge_grab_and_getup.classification: setFrontWallType() writes mFrontWallType from the height of the ledge above Link's feet; changeFrontWallTypeProc() then dispatches. Midair, mFrontWallType == 7 goes straight to HANG_START (voiceStart(10)).

entries.how: grab a ledge out of a fall (changeFrontWallTypeProc, src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:4780) or from the top of a rope (src/d/actor/d_a_player_rope.inc:936, :1278).
walk off an edge with a hangable wall below and a >125-unit drop (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:5348) - Link turns and catches instead of falling.
the direct wall catch for ledge type 7 (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main.cpp:4154, :4872, :7481).
ledge types 8/9: jump straight up, then catch or hang at the apex.

on_the_ledge.exits: stick toward the wall -> HANG_CLIMB; stick sideways with a valid neighbour (changeHangMoveProc) -> HANG_MOVE; changeHangEndProc(1) every frame handles letting go.

on_the_ledge.detail: the clip rate is getHangMoveAnmSpeed() (stick-scaled) and mNormalSpeed comes from the frame-to-frame change in hand separation (|right hand - left hand| x mHang.field_0x30), i.e. the shimmy is animation-driven.
the hand-over-hand pull used to re-grip; past mHang.field_0x1C it goes to HANG_CLIMB (arg 0), HANG_MOVE, or HANG_WAIT.

getting_up.detail: procHangClimb_init(f32 start_frame) is called with mWallCatch.field_0x2C as the start frame, so a wall catch skips into the clip rather than replaying it. The climb is pure root motion off vjmpcl.

letting_go.name: changeHangEndProc(int)
letting_go.what: Runs at the top of every hang proc; releases into FALL (nudging Link 8 units off the wall when HANG_UP was the source) or into the ship/rope hand-offs.

other_getups: LARGE_DAMAGE_UP (0x69) / LARGE_DAMAGE_WALL (0x6A): ANM_DAMFBUP / DAMFFUP / DAMFLUP / DAMFRUP are the knocked-down-and-up clips.
ICE_SLIP_FALL_UP (0x9F): the same DAMF*UP set after slipping on ice.
CRAWL_END (0x12): ANM_LIE played at crawl.crawl_end_anim_rate = -1.0 (in reverse) to stand up out of a crawl.

remake_enum.coverage: 27 remake states stand in for 84 of the 219 decomp procs; 135 procs (62%) have no counterpart, though ~50 of those are cutscene-only (0xA9-0xDA).

covered.note: the remake folds idle, run and both Z-target locomotion pairs into one state; WAIT_TURN and MOVE_TURN are not modelled.
FRONT_ROLL_CRASH is inlined as a rebound rather than its own state.
the three drop bands are handled with a frame counter, not with LAND_DAMAGE.
the `large` path plays damfb in the air but has no LARGE_DAMAGE_UP get-up.
the two step-off states are missing.
the eight other ship procs are missing.

ranked_missing.why: R with a shield is the single most-used defensive input in the game and the remake has no blocking state at all; GUARD_SLIP is what makes a blocked hit feel different from an unblocked one. All three are tuned by the existing mGuard / mCrouch HIO tables.
Holding B is a core sword verb, and CUT_TURN is also the combo-step-6 finisher, so its absence truncates the combo chain as well. Constants already mined as cutTurn / cutTurnR / cutRoll.

The remake's CUTS dictionary stops at cutea/cuteb; changeCutProc keeps chaining to steps 5 and 6, which is where the long combos players remember come from. Constants: cutExA / cutExB / cutExMJ / cutKesa.
The A-button counter (the flashing prompt over a guarding enemy) is Wind Waker's signature combat move and is entirely absent. Constants: battle / b_jump / b_roll / b_verJump.
Side hop and backflip are how you move while locked on; without them Z-targeting only strafes. Constants: sideStep / backJump.

The remake counts frames and keeps playing jmped for a damaging fall; the real game collapses, lies for 30 frames and stands back up, and big hits knock Link down entirely. This is the most visible 'feel' gap outside combat. Constants: fall (0x02-0x50) and dam / laDamage / huDamage / nockback.

changeSlideProc runs at the very top of checkNextMode, so on any steep polygon the real game overrides whatever the player asked for. Without it steep terrain behaves like flat ground. Constants: slip / slide.

checkNextMode picks WAIT_TURN for any stick request more than 0x7800 from the facing and MOVE_TURN for a reversal at speed; the remake just eases the yaw, which reads as sliding. SIDE_ROLL is the landing roll changeLandProc already wants.
Block puzzles are in almost every dungeon and the clips are already in LkAnm. Constants: pushpull.
The Skull Hammer gates Ganon's Tower and the Boko stick is the standard early-game weapon; both reuse one animation set. Constants: ham / cutBoko.
The remake toggles heavy/Iron Boots with no state and has no bottle use at all; these are the item verbs the inventory already implies. Constants: bottle / food / boots.
Forsaken Fortress stealth needs it, and the remake is already loading these clips - but for the wrong state (see clip_mismatches). Constants: wall.
Ice floors (Ice Ring Isle, Wind Temple) are a whole movement mode; setBlendMoveAnime already reaches for SLIPICE. Constants: iceSlip.
Sailing already works; boarding, getting off, the cannon and the salvage crane are the rest of the Great Sea loop. Constants: ship.
ranked_missing.caution: the SHIP_RESTART clip enum is ANM_SEARESET -> searest.bck by the naming rule; not independently confirmed.

ranked_missing.why: Spikes, lava and electric floors all currently do nothing distinct.
checkJumpFlower is called from procFall and checkNextMode, so these are wired into the core loop; they are how Boko Bulbs and warp pots move Link.
The heavy-object carry (GRAB_HEAVY_WAIT) changes movement speed and is what the mMove heavy fields exist for.
Medli / Makar escort sections need both halves of the Command Melody.
Each is one clip that removes a visible pop at the end of a traversal the remake already has.

The remake drives cutscene poses through a single ev_clip string. The real mapping is daPy_lk_c::mDemoProcInitFuncTable (src/d/actor/d_a_player_main_data.inc:444), 76 slots indexed by daPy_demo_c::Mode_e, 50 of them non-NULL; gcrip/data/ww_demo_anims.json already documents the .stb side. Implementing even the common half-dozen (DEMO_TALK, DEMO_OPEN_TREASURE, DEMO_GET_ITEM, DEMO_DOOR_OPEN, DEMO_NOD, DEMO_DEAD) would cover most retail scenes.
Small polish; FREE_WAIT is what events use instead of the idle-variation machinery.

clip_mismatches.note: mrolll/mrollr are the parry side-roll and the landing SIDE_ROLL; the A-button forward roll is ROLLF.
the wall*/wallw*/wallp* set is the wall-hide (WHIDE) family, src/d/actor/d_a_player_whide.inc:18; a vine wall is climbed with the ladder clips.
not wrong so much as half: jmped is only the upper-body half of the pair, jmpeds carries the legs.

clip_mismatches.decomp_clip: usefanb.bck (ANM_USEFANB), with usefanb2.bck for the gust variant

clip_mismatches.remake: damf when the hit is roughly frontal, damb behind, daml/damr to the sides
clip_mismatches.decomp: getDirectionFromAngle(damage vector vs facing): DIR_BACKWARD -> DAMF, DIR_LEFT -> DAMR, DIR_RIGHT -> DAML, otherwise -> DAMB
clip_mismatches.note: the game names its damage clips by the direction Link is thrown, not by where the hit came from, and it swaps left/right relative to the naive reading - worth re-checking the remake's four-way branch against this.

_gap.confidence: high for the state coverage and the clip mismatches (both sides read directly); medium for the ranking itself, which is a judgement call about play value.
